title: Find the top-2 (or top-K) highest-frequency elements in a list using a HashMap
hint: Count frequencies in a HashMap, then pick the top K using a min-heap of size K or bucket sort by frequency.

title: Group a list of strings into anagram groups
hint: Use a HashMap whose key is the sorted characters (or a 26-count signature) of each word, with a list of originals as values.

title: Find the longest consecutive sequence in an unsorted array in O(n)
hint: Put all numbers in a HashSet and only start counting from numbers whose predecessor is absent, extending while the next number exists.

title: Given a list of numbers, find the subarray whose sum equals a target (prefix-sum + HashMap)
hint: Keep a running prefix sum and a HashMap of prefix sums seen; if current minus target was seen earlier, a matching subarray exists.

title: Design and implement an LRU Cache using LinkedHashMap (or a HashMap + doubly linked list)
hint: Use a HashMap for O(1) lookup plus a doubly linked list for recency order, moving nodes to the head on access and evicting the tail.
